notices.html: Six Flags' reimagined Holiday in the Park opens to the public this Saturday, Nov 21, 1pm to 8pm (passholder preview was Friday the 20th, 4 to 8pm). Included with park admission and with Silver, Gold and Prestige passes: four new themed lands, a 65-foot tree, nightly tree lighting and s'mores fire pits. Opening weekend, so expect a crowd.

Polar Express tickets, first dates are next weekend: Nov 27 to 29 at both Whippany (Morristown & Erie) and Phillipsburg (Delaware River Railroad), then Dec 4 to 6, 11 to 13, and 18 to 20. These sell out, so if you want a date, book this week.

Pick-your-own is finished for the season at all six farms we track. Terhune's Winery Weekend Music Series still runs Saturdays and Sundays through November, noon to 5pm with live music 1 to 4pm, and farm markets and bakeries are open daily for Thanksgiving pies and turkey orders. Call before driving to any farm expecting to pick something.

blurbs.terhune: This weekend: no apple picking, the 2026 season is listed unavailable on the farm's own site. The Winery Weekend Music Series keeps running Saturday and Sunday, noon to 5pm with live music 1 to 4pm at the vineyard tasting room, free to attend. Thanksgiving is the 26th, so call 609-924-2310 now about pies and pre-orders rather than showing up Thanksgiving week.
blurbs.leeturkey: This weekend: Thanksgiving is Nov 26, and this is the farm's busiest stretch, they fill around 1,000 turkeys most years. Call 609-448-0629 before you drive over, both to order and to check what's still pickable in the fields.
blurbs.vonthun: This weekend: the fall festival and corn maze season has wrapped, leaving just the farm market. Hours can shrink heading into the holidays, so call 732-329-8656 to confirm before you go.
blurbs.emerys: This weekend: berries are long done, and the corn maze and hayrides were only listed through late October, so that part of the season is over too. Call the picking hotline at 609-758-8514 or check emerysfarm.com before you go.
blurbs.battleview: This weekend: still no apple picking, the spring freeze wiped out the whole crop, the farm's first total loss in five generations. The country store stays open 9am to 5pm daily except Tuesdays, with cider donuts made from sourced apples and a full bakery case. Call 732-462-0756 if you're coming for anything specific.
blurbs.johnsons: This weekend: the weekend Harvest Festival and corn maze have typically run only through October, so expect just the farm store and bakery. They bake thousands of pies for Thanksgiving and now offer drive-through pickup, so call 609-654-8643 or check johnsonsfarm.com to get your order in.
blurbs.diggerland: This weekend: Diggerfest ended Nov 15 and the park is heading into its winter break. Check the park's own calendar before driving down, since off-season weekends are not all open.
blurbs.sixflags: This weekend is opening day for the reimagined Holiday in the Park, Saturday Nov 21, 1pm to 8pm, included with park admission and with Silver, Gold and Prestige passes. Four new themed lands, a 65-foot tree, nightly tree lighting, Santa photos and s'mores fire pits. Runs select dates through Jan 3. A Black Friday deal has a 2027 Silver Pass for $79 through Nov 30 with a free Bring-A-Friend ticket. Check sixflags.com/greatadventure for the date calendar and tickets.
blurbs.morven: This weekend: Festival of Trees just opened Nov 18, decorated trees and mantels fill the historic house's galleries for the holidays through Jan 10. Regular museum admission applies, check morven.org for hours.

events.title: Family planetarium, inside an inflatable dome
events.desc: Step inside a portable planetarium and find the stars, constellations and planets you can actually look for that night. All ages, free, run by the library at the Community Center gym on New Road.
events.note: As of last check only the 1:30 session had seats, 3pm and 4:30pm were full

events.title: Lenni-Lenape crafts and stories
events.desc: Native American Heritage Month, run with the West Windsor Historical Society: crafts and stories about the Lenni-Lenape who lived here. Free, 20 seats when checked.
events.note: Our own branch, five minutes away, confirmed on the branch's November newsletter

events.title: Art for Families: Repeat It
events.desc: Drop-in family art making in the Creativity Labs, no registration and no admission charge. Open Studio follows 1 to 4:30pm if they want to keep going, and 12 to 4:30pm on Sunday.
events.note: Free, drop in any time in the window

events.title: Read to JoJo the therapy dog
events.desc: Fifteen-minute slots where a child reads out loud to a certified therapy dog. Ages 5 and up, free.
events.note: Arrive a few minutes early to pick your slot

events.title: Creative writing workshop, grades 5 and up
events.desc: City Kidz World Magazine runs a hands-on workshop turning a real memory into a written story. Free, registration required.
events.note: Two hours, good fit for the older one

events.title: Holiday in the Park opening day
events.desc: First public day of the rebuilt Holiday in the Park: four themed lands, a 65-foot tree, nightly tree lighting, Santa photos and s'mores fire pits. Included with park admission and with Silver, Gold and Prestige passes.

events.title: Turkey rock painting
events.desc: Paint a turkey onto a rock with acrylic markers, instruction provided. Ages 4 to 12, free, 8 seats when checked.
events.note: Half an hour, dress for mess

events.title: Public speaking for grades 5 to 8
events.desc: Speak Spark: games and activities that build up to real public speaking, leadership and collaboration. Free, registration required. A grades 2 to 4 session runs at 2pm.

events.title: Festival of Trees opens
events.desc: Decorated trees and mantels fill the historic house's galleries for the holidays, new this year. Included with regular admission, check morven.org for current hours and prices.
events.note: Just opened Nov 18, runs through Jan 10

events.title: Winter Chalet makers' market
events.desc: Four lit chalets on the plaza beside the library, plus about fifteen weekend booths that rotate every week, so it is a different market each time. Free to walk through, runs Thursday to Sunday until Dec 20.
events.note: Week two of five, vendors change weekly

events.title: Drop-in board games
events.desc: Turn up any time in the window and play, from the library's collection or bring your own. All ages, free, no registration at all.
events.note: No booking, five minutes away, good rainy-Sunday default

events.title: Python for beginners, session 3
events.desc: Hands-on beginner Python bootcamp for kids, guided practice and small projects. Free, 8 seats when checked. Bring your own laptop.

events.title: Thanksgiving storytime and craft
events.desc: Thanksgiving stories with Ms. Teri followed by a themed craft. Ages 5 and under, free, registration required, 8 seats when checked. A Spanish Day of the Dead storytime follows at 3pm.

extraPlaces.name: Winter Chalet Market, Hinds Plaza
extraPlaces.blurb: Four lit wooden chalets on the plaza beside Princeton Public Library, plus around fifteen weekend booths selling jewellery, ceramics, candles, prints, woodwork and kids' clothes. The weekend vendors rotate every week, so it is worth more than one visit, and it is the easiest Christmas shopping within fifteen minutes. Free to walk through.
extraPlaces.meta: Hinds Plaza, 66 Witherspoon Street, Princeton. Thursday to Sunday noon to 6pm, Nov 12 through Dec 20. Walk to Nassau Street for dinner afterwards.
